titleEs: D4Builds Overlay vs Mobalytics Overlay — duelo de overlays in-game
titleEn: D4Builds Overlay vs Mobalytics Overlay — in-game overlay showdown
descriptionEs: Ambos overlays in-game vía Overwolf platform. Diferencia central: cuál hub editorial trae a tu overlay. La decisión depende de cuál hub usas más.
descriptionEn: Both in-game overlays via Overwolf platform. Central difference: which editorial hub brings to your overlay. Choice depends on which hub you use more.
verdictEs: Si Mobalytics es tu hub primary (visual cards, tier lists), Mobalytics Overlay. Si D4Builds (community sharing, Rob2628 curated), D4Builds Overlay. Functionally similar — el content del hub es lo que decide.
verdictEn: If Mobalytics is your primary hub (visual cards, tier lists), Mobalytics Overlay. If D4Builds (community sharing, Rob2628 curated), D4Builds Overlay. Functionally similar — the hub content is what decides.

useCases.reasonEs: D4Builds Overlay accede al ecosystem D4Builds.gg con community builds voted-up. Mobalytics Overlay shows mostly Mobalytics-curated content.
useCases.reasonEn: D4Builds Overlay accesses D4Builds.gg ecosystem with community voted-up builds. Mobalytics Overlay shows mostly Mobalytics-curated content.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics' brand strength son tier lists visual con S/A/B/C badges. Overlay refleja eso. D4Builds tiene tier list pero menos visual-first.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics' brand strength is visual tier lists with S/A/B/C badges. Overlay reflects that. D4Builds has tier lists but less visual-first.

useCases.reasonEs: D4Builds Overlay incluye el planner integrado. Mobalytics tiene planner pero el overlay simplifica el access.
useCases.reasonEn: D4Builds Overlay includes the integrated planner. Mobalytics has a planner but the overlay simplifies access.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics es multi-game. Si usas Mobalytics for LoL plus D4, single Overwolf account + overlay covers both.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics is multi-game. If you use Mobalytics for LoL plus D4, single Overwolf account + overlay covers both.

useCases.reasonEs: D4Builds.gg updatea community-driven que reacciona rápido. Mobalytics' editorial update toma 1-2 días más vs D4Builds.gg's organic flow.
useCases.reasonEn: D4Builds.gg updates community-driven that reacts fast. Mobalytics' editorial update takes 1-2 days more vs D4Builds.gg's organic flow.
